P-R1.what: Creating a portfolio for a user who has none
P-R1.why: Creating a profile and a portfolio is the first-run flow of the Settings ticket.

P-O1.what: The Optimizer tab and its Available to trade box still show the retired suggestions model
P-O1.why: The optimizer's stored proposals replace it in the Optimizer ticket; this page does not touch that tab.

P-S1.what: The portfolio's optimizer settings (PortfolioResponse.settings) are not shown
P-S1.why: They are owner rules edited in Settings, not a Portfolio page figure.

P-D1.what: Return against the benchmark fund is unavailable while the fund has no price history
P-D1.why: The report says so (performance.fund.available is false with a reason); the fund's price history is a backend data job.

P-D2.what: The change at the last close may include cash the owner added or took out that day
P-D2.why: The value history does not say how much cash moved each day; net_flow_cad is requested from the backend. Until then the figure is flagged when the cost base or cash changed between the two days.

P-C1.what: The currency of a holding's realised gain is not stated by the API
P-C1.why: HoldingResponse.total_realized_gain_loss has no currency in its description; it is shown in the stock's currency.

P-C2.what: A closed position's realised percent is unavailable
P-C2.why: Holdings carry the realised amount but no percent and no CAD amount.

P-A1.what: Allocation by geography is replaced by allocation by currency
P-A1.why: The API has no country for a stock; exposure reports currency.

P-A2.what: Allocation for a single account (TFSA, RRSP or Trading)
P-A2.why: The exposure report has no account filter yet; until it has, the sector, industry and currency donuts say they cover the whole portfolio.

P-H1.what: The numeric Bull and Bear disagreement score is not shown
P-H1.why: The snapshot serves the disagreement class (consensus, mild dissent, split decision, high conflict), not the score.

P-H2.what: The change in price over the day is derived, not served
P-H2.why: The snapshot gives the change as a fraction; the amount is the price less price / (1 + change).

P-H3.what: Dividend per share is the analysis's expected income over its horizon, not the last year's payments
P-H3.why: The snapshot serves income_per_share from the price band; the old annual_dividend_per_share has no source.

P-H5.what: A holding's note can be read but not edited
P-H5.why: No route changes a holding's notes.

P-F1.what: The report's per-stock lines, who-and-why, breakdowns and action list are not shown
P-F1.why: Holdings and Transactions already carry the same per-holding and per-action figures; a Reports view is a separate feature.

P-F2.what: The tax-year refund block of the report is not shown
P-F2.why: It is an untyped record in the API.

P-W4.why: The ledger never overwrites: this becomes Correct, Remove and Confirm with the broker in the writes ticket.

P-W7.why: The correct preview and call are the writes ticket.

P-W8.why: The reverse call is the writes ticket.

P-T1.why: The API serves reverses_transaction_id on the reversing row only, so the page marks a reversed row only when its reversing row is on the loaded page.

P-W10.what: The entry preview's tax, room and gain figures are untyped
P-W10.why: The preview serves row, estimated_tax and room as untyped objects, so the page reads them by their documented keys: marginal_rate is a whole percent (31.48, no unit marker protects it) and a sale at a loss returns a negative estimated_tax, shown as a saving. Typed models with unit markers are a backend follow-up.

P-W11.what: Recording an RRSP contribution for the previous tax year (January and February)
P-W11.why: The form does not send tax_year, so a contribution counts for the year of its date; the API allows the prior year during the first 60 days.

P-W12.what: Marking a trade as following an optimizer proposal
P-W12.why: recommendation_id is not sent: proposals are shown by the Optimizer ticket, which links a trade to the proposal it follows.

P-S2.what: Editing an account's settings (commission per trade, conversion cost, reinvest dividends, Norbert's gambit)
P-S2.why: The PATCH route exists; the form belongs with the account settings in the Settings ticket.

E-1.what: Mock mode cannot reproduce server-side filtering and paging, so the Transactions filter flows are not tested end to end
E-1.why: A recorded file is the same for every query. The Transactions filters are covered by the live run (npm run test:e2e:live) against a seeded scratch backend.

P-W9.what: Adding a stock by company name
P-W9.why: The backend lookup (GET /api/stocks/lookup) takes a ticker only, so Add Stock and the Watchlist search by ticker.
